purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Rio Verde

queries.query: Rio Verde Goiás official cadastral map parcel GIS public lot service
queries.result: First-party municipal results identified Rio Verde 360º, a public urban-information map described by the Prefeitura as covering 86,056 municipal lots. The official site links the current viewer and the viewer's public app configuration exposes a parcel vector-tile layer.

queries.query: Rio Verde GO cadastro imobiliário mapa de lotes geoprocessamento prefeitura Rio Verde 360
queries.result: A busca em português found the municipal SUDERV service page, which describes Rio Verde 360º as a free consultation of urban information for Rio Verde lots; the municipal site also identifies the local urban-development and property-heritage custodians.

registryEvidence.custodian: Prefeitura Municipal de Rio Verde, through SUDERV / Rio Verde 360º; the municipal Superintendência de Patrimônio Imobiliário is a related cadastral/property-service custodian.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The municipal first-party pages explicitly describe Rio Verde 360º as a public lot/urban-information platform. This supports registryFound=true for a local public map/service, not ownership or title registration access.

parcelDiscovery.crs: WGS 84 (source property label; GeoJSON coordinates are longitude/latitude)
parcelDiscovery.note: The public app configuration identifies the Rio Verde territory as source_id 5218805 and its lot layer as rvrd_relation_lotes_legislation with promoteId ref_id. A bounded anonymous WFS response returned three full polygons near, but not containing, the exact WUP point; this is not treated as an exact-point absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200/official municipal page; linked Rio Verde 360º and stated coverage of 86,056 lots.
HTTP 200; current Wix viewer HTML/config inspected. It linked the public app at app.rioverde360.rioverde.go.gov.br.
HTTP 200 anonymous JSON; exposed territory Rio Verde - GO, IBGE source_id 5218805, and parcel vector-tile layer place-data:rvrd_relation_lotes_legislation with promoteId ref_id.
HTTP 200; WFS capabilities included place-data:rvrd_relation_lotes_legislation. The authkey was copied from the current public viewer configuration; no login or private credential was used.
HTTP 200 anonymous bounded GeoJSON; returned three polygon features with native ref_id values and source crs label WGS 84. Full unchanged safe geometry retained in the single sample file.

uncertainty: The exact WUP point did not fall within the three returned bounded features; this is not evidence of citywide absence and no coordinate was shifted.
The WFS layer is a municipal urban-lot legislation map service, not proof of legal title or complete cadastral registration coverage.

The public viewer's configuration token was used only for the anonymous public map service; no credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS exception, owner/address/contact/titleholder/personal/tax/account fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
